01 / MARKETING GROWTH

Find your audience.
Build your momentum.

Get your agent discovered by the right users, and connect every dollar of campaign spend to the revenue it creates.

Multi-channel distributionRevenue-based attributionAutomated campaigns
Let’s build your next chapter ↗
01Multi-channel intelligent distribution

Covers search, social, agent marketplaces, and model platforms, with unified budget and bidding strategy and targeting by country, industry, and user profile.

02Automated creative generation

Uses the agent's capability description and historical conversation data to generate multilingual ad copy, landing pages, and demos — then A/B tests them continuously.

03Transaction-level attribution

Campaign data is wired straight into the AI Payments module, so you can trace the full path from impression to click to trial to paid, and judge performance on real revenue rather than clicks.

04Budget–revenue coupling

Automatically recycle a configurable share of your agent's transaction revenue back into campaign budget, creating a self-sustaining, revenue-driven growth loop.

05Compliance and brand safety

Built-in advertising compliance rules and brand-safety filtering for each market, so your creative always meets local regulatory requirements.

02 / AI PAYMENTS

Payments that move
at the speed of agents.

Give every agent a verifiable payment identity, carefully scoped spending authority, and the ability to collect, pay, and settle.

Fiat & stablecoinHuman-to-agentAgent-to-agent
Let’s build your next chapter ↗
01Agent payment identity and authorization

Issue each agent its own payment credential, with user-defined limits, merchant scope, and validity windows — so an agent can only transact inside what it was authorized to do.

02Multiple payment methods

Card Virtual cards and network tokens issued via tokenization, compatible with the major card networks.

Stablecoin Compliant stablecoin collection, disbursement, and automatic conversion.

Local Local wallets and transfer rails across key markets.

03Agent-to-agent protocol payments

Native support for A2A, MCP, UCP, and X402 agent payment and communication protocols, so agents can settle with each other automatically per call, per task outcome, or per subscription period.

04Real-time risk control and compliance

An agent-specific risk model built on years of payments risk experience — anomalous-call detection, limit management, AML screening, and transaction monitoring — aligned with regulatory requirements in Singapore, Hong Kong, and the United States.

05Automatic reconciliation and settlement

Every transaction is booked in real time, with automatic multi-currency, multi-entity reconciliation and revenue-share settlement that plugs directly into enterprise finance systems.

03 / FUEL SUPPLY

The right resources.
Ready for every task.

Connect to foundation models, token compute, and licensed content through a single integration. Keep your agent running at the right cost.

Intelligent routingLicensed contentUsage-based billing
Let’s build your next chapter ↗

TOKEN SUPPLY

01One integration, every major model

A single interface to the leading foundation models, automatically selecting the best model for each task by type, cost, and latency requirements.

02Bulk procurement and cost optimization

Preferential rates through pooled, at-scale procurement, plus caching, compression, and routing strategies that cut actual token consumption.

03Quota management and prepayment

Set token quotas per agent or per project, prepay in fiat or stablecoin, and net automatically against revenue from the AI Payments module.

04Reliability guarantees

Multi-supplier redundancy and automatic failover keep agents available through traffic spikes and provider incidents.

CONTENT SUPPLY

05Licensed content and data sources

Authorized news, industry data, product information, and professional knowledge bases — content your agent can legally use.

06On-demand calls, usage-based billing

Content is delivered through standard interfaces; agents pay for what they actually call, and fees settle automatically to the content owner through AI Payments.

07Onboarding for content suppliers

Content and data owners can list their assets as agent-consumable services and open up a new revenue stream.

08Usage records and rights traceability

Every content call is logged in full, keeping ownership unambiguous and revenue sharing transparent.

04 / MONETIZATION

Intelligence creates value.
Make it your business.

Pricing, metering, collection, and revenue share. Bring every part of your agent’s business together, and grow with real revenue data.

Flexible pricingAutomatic settlementRevenue analytics
Let’s build your next chapter ↗
01Flexible business-model configuration

Subscription, per-call, outcome-based pricing, capability licensing, and revenue share — combinable per customer segment.

02Usage metering and real-time billing

Precisely meter the resource consumption and output of every call and every task, auto-generate invoices, and push them to AI Payments for collection.

03Agent marketplace and distribution

List your agent on the platform marketplace so enterprise buyers and other agents can discover, trial, and purchase it — with Marketing Growth wired in for promotion.

04Multi-party revenue share and automatic settlement

For tasks completed jointly by several agents and content providers, revenue is split by predefined rules and settled to each party automatically, with no manual intervention.

05Revenue analytics and growth guidance

Dashboards for revenue, cost, gross margin, and customer retention — plus data-driven recommendations on pricing and campaign spend.
